scenes.vo: My night bus ticket said seat fourteen B. The bus only had thirteen rows.
scenes.cap: My ticket said seat 14B. The bus only had 13 rows.

scenes.vo: I showed the conductor. He didn't even look up. Back of the bus, he said. Row fourteen is always there after midnight.
scenes.cap: Conductor: "Row 14 is always there after midnight."

scenes.vo: At twelve sharp, I walked to the back. There it was. One extra row. Four seats. Three people, fast asleep.
scenes.cap: 12:00. One extra row. Three passengers, fast asleep.

scenes.vo: Their tickets were in their laps. Same route. Same seat numbers. But every ticket was dated a year ago.
scenes.cap: Their tickets: same route. Dated one year ago.

scenes.vo: I sat down. The man next to me opened one eye and whispered. You're new. Whatever happens, don't look out of the window when the bus stops.
scenes.cap: "You're new. Don't look out of the window when the bus stops."

scenes.vo: Then the bus stopped. And someone outside tapped on my window. Part two tomorrow. What would you do?
scenes.cap: The bus stopped. Something tapped on my window. Part 2 tomorrow.
